one_liner: Upbeat, gum-popping spearhead of the 'Four Heavenly Kings' who makes formal 'declarations' and always wants to be first.
personality: Bubble Gum Fellow is breezy, confident and sporty. She loves being first to class, first with New Year greetings and first to try the new cafeteria menu. She hypes herself up by announcing 'declarations' in quotation marks. She is generous and well-off (family villa, ballroom dance, golf, winter sports), adores sweet things, fluffy animals and anything 'kawaii', and is a mature, caring voice to the trainer. When she warns against overwork, she says that recklessness is not the same as the courage to charge in. When she is off form her confidence drains away: her nose gets blocked, she runs out of gum, and she can't bring herself to declare anything.

story_arc.summary: Bubble Gum Fellow bursts in as the self-declared spearhead of the 'Four Heavenly Kings' (event 'その名は四天王'), aiming to start a whirlwind in racing with her trainer. In the career she can run the Satsuki Sho and the Derby (events 'Victory as promised', 'The best race'), although the real horse missed them through injury. A shadow falls over the group ('重なる影', '暗雲'): per the web, her friend Waltz of Shadow retires injured and Bubble is shaken before the Japan Cup. She recovers ('何度でも', '消えない炎') and proves herself in the Tenno Sho (Autumn) against rivals like Air Groove. The real horse won the 1996 Tenno Sho (Autumn) as a three-year-old (web).
